failures.fix: Fix mock stage scripts to write plan.md/review.md artifacts before stage completion and sanitize the complexity value passed to jq in the low-complexity intelligence test

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: Multiple pipeline/loop stages (plan, review, resume, full E2E) fail to write expected artifacts (plan.md, review.md) because the build/test loop's self-healing retry logic doesn't consistently regenerate artifacts on iteration, and a jq parse error on non-numeric complexity output breaks the low-complexity skip check
failures.fix: Fix jq numeric parsing in the complexity intelligence check (quote/validate the value before passing to jq) and ensure pipeline_write_plan/pipeline_write_review are called unconditionally before stage completion so retries don't skip artifact generation

failures.fix: Clear/reset stale pipeline locks before e2e-integration-test runs (or add lock cleanup in test teardown), add version/goal/criteria fields to analyze_intent's generated JSON, and fix/re-check the loop stuckness detection logic in sw-loop.sh

failures.root_cause: One test assertion in the 78-test suite failed during the test stage run

failures.fix: Clear/reset the stale pipeline lock before the e2e-integration suite runs (or auto-detect and abort orphaned locks), and update analyze_intent to populate version, goal, and criteria in its generated JSON
